note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI sends a 5-model Burna unit toward a distant left-side screen point it cannot reach, cutting it off from its army. The unit is unlikely to arrive there and is exposed on the way. Fix: Score screen points on reachability. Penalise distance heavily, and reject or cut screen_base to near zero when the point is more than one move away. Also add a term that penalises ending the move far from friendly units, and prefer moving to the nearest friendly-held objective or the army when a unit is isolated.
